Verdict: SHIP

1.  **Pen Group Chips:** The "Default pen" and "Curve pen" chips are clearly visible, have distinct borders/backgrounds indicating they are interactive (LIVE), and the "Default pen" is visually selected with a solid black background and white text.
2.  **Mode Toggle:** The mode toggle in the top-left corner of the map area displays a pencil icon with the text "Drawing" and a keyboard shortcut "D", correctly showing that Draw mode is currently active.
3.  **Layout & Text:** The UI layout is clean and well-organized. All text within the sidebar, map overlays, and header is fully legible without any clipping or overlapping elements.
